is: each place's sounds that belong to no object: the room tones it plays all the time (loops, by their names in data/sound/catalogue.json and sounds.json), and, outside on the Moon, what is heard through the suit instead (heard_through). tools/usd/sound.py writes them into the place's stage as non-spatial UsdMedia.SpatialAudio

hub.from: PlaceSounds.LOOPS (the game 2099's game/sound/places/place_sounds.gd:31-43): the hub is the habitat's room id drawn as the C12 room

airlock.from: PlaceSounds.LOOPS (the game 2099's game/sound/places/place_sounds.gd:31-43): the airlock plays the base's hum alone

tube.from: PlaceSounds.LOOPS (the game 2099's game/sound/places/place_sounds.gd:31-43): the west and east corridors

lab.from: PlaceSounds.LOOPS (the game 2099's game/sound/places/place_sounds.gd:31-43) names no lab, so the game plays nothing there; the base's hum is laid here as under every other room of the base (its brief: 'under every room of the base')

garage.from: PlaceSounds.LOOPS (the game 2099's game/sound/places/place_sounds.gd:31-43) has no garage yet ('There is no garage yet, so none is played'); the garage's own generated tone (its brief: 'the garage where the rover is kept') and the base's hum are laid here

hangar.from: PlaceSounds.LOOPS (the game 2099's game/sound/places/place_sounds.gd:31-43) has no hangar; the base's hum is laid here as under every room of the base

camp.from: PlaceSounds.LOOPS (the game 2099's game/sound/places/place_sounds.gd:31-43) and Hearing: inside the camp on Mars the game plays no place's loop (Mars inside is no base room)

wreck.from: PlaceSounds.LOOPS (the game 2099's game/sound/places/place_sounds.gd:31-43): outside on the Moon there is no air and no place is heard, only the suit; SuitSounds (the game 2099's game/sound/suit/suit_sounds.gd:3-9, 27-48): out on the Moon or on Mars the suit's fans run and the player breathes, calm while walking

flat.from: PlaceSounds.LOOPS (the game 2099's game/sound/places/place_sounds.gd:31-43) FLAT: the flat in the prologue and through the wait on Earth

stairwell.from: PlaceSounds.LOOPS (the game 2099's game/sound/places/place_sounds.gd:31-43) and _earth_place: the flat plays on down the stairs (the stairwell cut it to silence in the first playthrough, 2026-10-01)
